rows.label: Purpose
rows.text: Authorize requests to protected APIs and resources.

rows.label: Where it is stored
rows.text: In memory or a secure, HttpOnly cookie.

rows.label: When it is sent
rows.text: Included in the Authorization header with API requests.

rows.label: Revocation behavior
rows.text: Expires quickly; server-side revocation requires additional mechanisms.

items.text: A short-lived token used to access protected APIs on behalf of a user.
items.title: Access Token

rows.label: Purpose
rows.text: Get a new access token without logging in again.

rows.label: Where it is stored
rows.text: In a secure, HttpOnly cookie or other protected storage.

rows.label: When it is sent
rows.text: Sent to the refresh endpoint only.

rows.label: Revocation behavior
rows.text: Can be revoked on logout and rotated for stronger security.

items.text: A long-lived credential used to obtain new access tokens when they expire.
